content_sections.heading: Braithwaite & Co Ltd Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Braithwaite & Co Ltd, a Government of India Undertaking, has officially released the Braithwaite & Co Ltd Recruitment 2026 Notification under Reference No. WII/ 2026/ 3 for the recruitment of 29 contractual positions across multiple technical, managerial, engineering, commercial, and safety disciplines. The notification invites applications for posts such as GM/ DGM (Projects), Senior Manager, Manager, Deputy Manager, Assistant Manager, Engineer (Mechanical & Electrical), and Safety Officer. The official notification contains complete details regarding vacancy distribution, educational qualifications, experience requirements, application procedure, selection process, required documents, and important instructions. Eligible candidates are advised to read the notification carefully before submitting their application via email. Applications must be forwarded on or before 10 September 2026.
